usedMock.description: True when no real provider was configured and a deterministic mock image was used (quota-safe fallback).

sourceJobId.description: Remote provider job id, for audit. Null in mock mode. Never a stored-asset reference.

storageKey.description: Scratch (transfer) key for the standardized image under .forgeax/games/<slug>/.gen3d/tmp/. NOT a 3D asset (no manifest, not in list-assets); use as the upstream input for a later gen3d:image-to-3d call.

sourceUrl.description: The provider's temporary output URL the image was downloaded from. Audit only; never the canonical reference.
